_comment: ARMOURED kit: the sensor blister, and the ONLY piece of this look that breaks the plane of the hull. An octagonal armour ring, a faceted hood over it, and a glossy optic sunk into the top - the one shiny thing on a ship whose whole palette is matte. Eight sides everywhere: a smooth dome would read as civilian, and the facets are what keep it in the same language as the plate under it.
